description: Numbered 2x3 montage with six clear multi-angle views of one ripe Hass avocado backing the focal oval; confident ripe call expected.
Numbered 2x3 montage with six clear multi-angle views of an under-ripe green Hass avocado; confident unripe call expected.
Numbered 2x3 montage with six clear multi-angle views of an overripe Hass avocado with visible sunken indentations; confident overripe call expected.
Montage of numbered cream tiles with no produce inside; the Clef gate must deny with no_produce, no Gemini call.
Montage with heavy motion blur on every tile; gate denies with unclear_photo.
Montage rendered nearly black on every tile; gate denies with unclear_photo.
Numbered 2x3 montage showing the same side repeatedly without rotation; expects insufficient_evidence with abstentionReason same_side_only and manual checks.

Numbered 2x3 montage of one dark-speckled Hass avocado rotated while a fingertip presses it; the skin visibly dents under the press in several tiles. Visible give must count as softness evidence: confident ripe call, ready to eat now (readyInDays.min 0, max at most 1). Labelled from the shopper report that the fruit was soft to touch.

Numbered 2x3 montage of an overripe mandarin rotated while pressed; tiles 1 and 2 show deep horizontal surface creases and puffy loose peel around the stem, and tile 3 shows the peel folding and collapsing under finger pressure. Must classify as overripe with a low visual score (<= 4.5).

Numbered 2x3 montage of a second overripe mandarin whose unpressed outer peel appears round in tiles 1, 2 and 6, but in tiles 3, 4 and 5 finger pressure causes a deep hollow cave-in with concentric radial skin folds around the pressing thumb. Must classify as overripe with a low visual score (<= 4.5).

Numbered 2x3 montage of an underripe green pear held upright and rotated while the thumb rests against its tapered neck/side without any inward skin deformation; must not hallucinate press give from the natural pear silhouette and must classify as unripe.
